title: Ascend SIMD/SIMT Route Model profile
description: Target-specific policy, calibration, priors, and measurement references used to rank all-SIMD, all-SIMT, and mixed SIMD/SIMT candidates.
$comment: Standard JSON has no // comments. Property descriptions in this schema are the canonical field comments for Route Model profiles.

$schema.description: Relative path to this JSON Schema; used by editors and offline validators, not by Route Model scoring.

schema_version.description: Machine-readable Route Model layout version. The current v5 profile requires schema version 2.

profile_version.description: Version identifier accepted by the C++ Route Model loader and emitted in decision reports.

target.description: Canonical target for this calibration; it must equal the target of the referenced shared microbenchmark profile.

description.description: Human-readable ownership boundary and purpose of this Route Model profile.

microbenchmark_profile.description: Path, relative to this file, to the model-neutral hardware measurement profile.

compatible_targets.description: Additional wildcard target aliases accepted by the target-compatibility gate.

items.description: One case-insensitive wildcard target pattern; '*' and '?' are supported.

score_unit.description: Unit label for candidate scores. Values retain SYS_CNT-cycle structure but are selection scores after empirical residual calibration.

confidence.description: Evidence confidence ordered as none < low < medium < high.

policy.description: Decision-admission policy applied after candidate scoring.

description.description: Human-readable scope and current loader-consumption status of this policy object.

minimum_confidence_for_decision.description: Minimum final ranking-confidence level required by the confidence gate.

unknown_op.description: Documented handling intent for unknown operations. The current C++ loader does not consume this field; unsupported terms are collected directly during analysis.

notes.description: Free-form explanation of score semantics and the gates that remain mandatory; not parsed as policy logic.

selection_calibration.description: Model-specific scale, confidence, domain bounds, and residual terms used for route ranking.

description.description: Human-readable role and evidence boundary of the complete calibration object.

program_issue_scale.description: Multiplier applied to both SIMD and SIMT issue payloads after their compute-versus-memory roofline maximum; setup cost is not multiplied.

ranking_confidence.description: Confidence assigned to Event-calibrated structural residuals; inside a covered structural domain it is combined with resource and transition confidence by taking the lowest level.

tiny_dot_mixed_penalty_ratio_at_zero.description: Maximum Event-fitted mixed-versus-SIMT residual ratio at complete tiny-dot underfill; it decreases linearly to zero at tiny_dot_flops_max.

source.description: Workloads, measurements, and rollout boundary from which the route-specific calibration was derived. It is loaded into profile metadata but currently does not affect scoring or reports.

coverage.description: Feature-domain admission bounds for trusting Event-calibrated ranking residuals.

description.description: Meaning of these thresholds and warning that they are model-validity limits, not hardware limits.

minimum_irregular_density.description: Minimum value of the current rank-based pointer irregularity proxy required by calibrated irregular domains. The proxy is rank>1 pointer-operation count divided by unique ranked tensor-shape count across tt.addptr/tt.load/tt.store; it does not inspect actual address strides or lane dependence.

tiny_dot_flops_max.description: Maximum dot FLOP count admitted to the tiny-gather-dot calibration domain.

tiny_dot_max_tensor_numel.description: Maximum tensor element count admitted to the tiny-gather-dot calibration domain.

rowwise_loop_trip_sum_max.description: Maximum sum of statically known loop trip counts admitted to rowwise and rank-1 calibrated domains.

rowwise_mask_rank_sum_max.description: Maximum sum of ranks of mask-producing tensor expressions admitted to the masked-rowwise calibration domain.

rowwise_weighted_reductions_max.description: Maximum loop-execution-weighted tt.reduce count admitted to the masked-rowwise calibration domain. Each reduce contributes the product of its enclosing static scf.for trip counts.

rowwise_max_tensor_numel.description: Maximum tensor element count admitted to the masked-rowwise calibration domain.

rank1_weighted_reductions_max.description: Maximum loop-execution-weighted tt.reduce count admitted to the rank-1 indirect vector-reduction domain. Each reduce contributes the product of its enclosing static scf.for trip counts.

rank1_max_tensor_numel.description: Maximum tensor element count admitted to the rank-1 indirect vector-reduction domain.

simd_structural_penalty.description: Parameters for the additive structural penalty ratio that raises the all-SIMD candidate floor relative to all-SIMT.

description.description: Human-readable meaning of the all-SIMD structural residual model.

irregular_per_density.description: All-SIMD penalty ratio per unit of the current rank-based pointer irregularity proxy outside the tiny-dot special case.

irregular_cap.description: Maximum penalty ratio contributed by the rank-based pointer irregularity proxy outside the tiny-dot special case.

tiny_dot_irregular_per_density.description: All-SIMD penalty ratio per unit of the rank-based pointer irregularity proxy for tiny-dot workloads.

tiny_dot_irregular_cap.description: Maximum penalty ratio contributed by the rank-based pointer irregularity proxy for tiny-dot workloads.

per_mask_rank.description: All-SIMD mask-materialization penalty ratio added per unit of mask_rank_sum.

per_weighted_reduction.description: All-SIMD reduction-lowering penalty ratio per loop-execution-weighted tt.reduce.

per_static_loop_trip.description: All-SIMD loop-control penalty ratio per statically known loop trip.

control_flow.description: Fixed all-SIMD structural penalty ratio when control flow is present.

rank1_indirect_vector_reduction.description: Fixed all-SIMD penalty ratio for the rank-1 indirect vector-reduction pattern.

tiny_dot.description: Maximum tiny-dot startup penalty ratio, multiplied by the computed underfill fraction.

tiny_dot_flops_max.description: FLOP count at which tiny-dot underfill and its startup penalty reach zero.

mixed_simd_fraction.description: Parameters estimating what fraction of a normal mixed candidate payload follows the all-SIMD rather than all-SIMT cost. Tiny-dot scoring overrides this blend with its dedicated residual formula.

description.description: Human-readable meaning of the mixed-payload blend.

base.description: Baseline SIMD share before feature-dependent increments.

per_static_loop_trip.description: SIMD-share increment per statically known loop trip.

loop_cap.description: Maximum SIMD-share increment contributed by static loops.

mask_cap.description: Maximum SIMD-share increment contributed by mask broadcasts.

reduction_cap.description: Maximum SIMD-share increment contributed by reductions.

control_flow.description: Fixed SIMD-share increment when control flow is present.

tiny_dot.description: Fixed SIMD-share increment for tiny-dot patterns before their dedicated residual override.

max.description: Upper bound applied to the final mixed SIMD fraction.

op_profiles.description: Map from semantic operation name to either a shared throughput measurement or a cycle multiplier relative to another operation.

op_profile.description: One SIMD or SIMT operation-cost rule.

description.description: Operation-specific provenance and interpretation of this rule.

throughput_measurement.description: Key of a throughput measurement in microbenchmark_profile.

throughput_vector_instructions_per_syste.description: Inline SIMD vector-instruction throughput fallback in vector instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

throughput_scalar_ops_per_system_cycle.description: Inline SIMT scalar-operation throughput fallback in scalar lane operations per SYS_CNT cycle.

relative_to.description: Operation name whose resolved throughput supplies the base cycle estimate.

factor.description: Multiplier applied to the resolved base cycle estimate; values above one make this operation slower.

confidence.description: Confidence of this measured or relative operation rule; when the operation occurs, it contributes to the resource-confidence minimum used by the gate.

description.description: Human-readable role of the all-SIMD model.

vector_width_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for physical SIMD vector width in bits.

vector_width_bits.description: Inline SIMD vector-width fallback supported by the loader when no measurement key is provided.

simd_startup.description: Legacy all-SIMD startup priors in SYS_CNT cycles.

description.description: Human-readable status and current consumption boundary of these startup priors.

vector.description: Fixed all-SIMD vector setup cost in SYS_CNT cycles; this is the only startup value currently consumed.

mte2.description: Legacy MTE2 startup prior in SYS_CNT cycles; currently not consumed by Route Model scoring.

mte3.description: Legacy MTE3 startup prior in SYS_CNT cycles; currently not consumed by Route Model scoring.

confidence.description: Documentary confidence of the legacy startup priors; the current Route Model loader does not consume it.

note.description: Evidence caveat retained for human review; not consumed by scoring.

simd_memory.description: All-SIMD memory rates and their model-specific provenance.

description.description: Human-readable role and consumption boundary of these rates.

hbm_bytes_per_system_cycle.description: Legacy whole-device HBM-rate seed in byte/SYS_CNT-cycle; currently not consumed by Route Model scoring.

vector_mte2_bytes_per_system_cycle.description: All-SIMD load-path rate in byte/SYS_CNT-cycle; load cycles equal load bytes divided by this value.

mte3_bytes_per_system_cycle.description: All-SIMD store-path rate in byte/SYS_CNT-cycle; store cycles equal store bytes divided by this value.

source.description: Origin and validity caveat of these model-specific rates.

confidence.description: Confidence of the all-SIMD memory rates; when load or store work exists, it contributes to the resource-confidence minimum used by the gate.

note.description: Warning that these are fallback Route Model inputs rather than shared isolated measurements.

dot_model.description: Fixed setup plus throughput model for dot work.

description.description: Human-readable role and execution mode of this dot model.

startup_system_cycles.description: Fixed dot setup cost in SYS_CNT cycles.

flops_per_system_cycle.description: Modeled dot arithmetic rate in FLOP per SYS_CNT cycle.

source.description: Origin and intended refinement path for the dot prior.

confidence.description: Confidence of this dot prior; when dot work exists, it contributes to the resource-confidence minimum used by the gate.

simt_model.description: All-SIMT resources plus mixed-mode setup evidence.

description.description: Human-readable role of the all-SIMT and mixed-mode inputs.

warp_size_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for the number of scalar lanes in one SIMT warp.

warp_size.description: Inline warp-size fallback supported by the loader when no measurement key is provided.

description.description: Human-readable meaning and source boundary of the setup cost.

empty_launch_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for standalone empty-SIMT setup in SYS_CNT cycles.

empty_launch.description: Inline empty-SIMT setup fallback in SYS_CNT cycles.

camodel_effective.description: Workload-effective CaModel rates retained as fallback calibration context.

description.description: Human-readable warning that only part of this block is currently consumed.

scope.description: Workload and active-vector-core scope from which these effective rates were derived.

simulator_clock_mhz.description: Clock used by the simulator-cycle measurements before conversion to SYS_CNT cycles.

conversion.description: Documentary formula used to convert aggregate simulator-cycle rates into SYS_CNT-cycle rates; not evaluated by the loader.

warp_size.description: Warp size assumed by the CaModel workload. The current loader uses simt.warp_size_measurement instead.

source.description: CaModel artifact and profiling run that produced these workload-effective rates.

confidence.description: Documentary confidence of the complete CaModel workload-effective block; the current loader does not propagate it to predicate-cost confidence or the gate.

note.description: Warning that these values include workload dependencies and stalls and are not isolated peak rates.

camodel_rates.description: Workload-effective aggregate warp-instruction issue rates in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle. The current loader consumes only predicate.

memory.description: Effective memory warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

float_alu.description: Effective floating-point ALU warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

shuffle.description: Effective shuffle warp-instruction rate; isolated shared measurement is used instead.

predicate.description: Effective predicate warp-instruction rate consumed to estimate mask predicate cycles.

control.description: Effective control warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

int_alu.description: Effective integer-ALU warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

description.description: Human-readable meaning and source boundary of the shuffle rate.

throughput_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for shuffle throughput in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

warp_instructions_per_system_cycle.description: Inline shuffle-throughput fallback supported by the loader.

confidence.description: Optional explicit shuffle confidence; otherwise confidence is inherited from the referenced shared measurement and contributes to the gate when shuffle work exists.

simt_memory.description: SIMT GM load/store warp-instruction issue-rate inputs.

description.description: Human-readable meaning and source boundary of the SIMT memory rates.

load_throughput_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for GM-load throughput in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

store_throughput_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for GM-store throughput in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

load_warp_instructions_per_system_cycle.description: Inline GM-load throughput fallback supported by the loader.

store_warp_instructions_per_system_cycle.description: Inline GM-store throughput fallback supported by the loader.

confidence.description: Optional explicit SIMT-memory confidence; otherwise the lower confidence of the referenced load/store measurements is used when memory work exists.

transitions.description: Map from measured warp count to complete mixed-mode empty-SIMT setup evidence.

confidence.description: Optional confidence override for mixed setup evidence; otherwise the referenced measurements provide transition confidence for structural-ranking admission.

note.description: Warning that the values are complete mixed setup proxies, not independently identified directional switch deltas.

transition_entry.description: Complete empty-SIMT setup proxy for one measured mixed-mode warp count.

description.description: Human-readable warp-count scope of this transition entry.

measurement.description: Shared measurement key for complete mixed empty-SIMT setup in SYS_CNT cycles.

empty_simt_setup_system_cycles.description: Inline complete mixed empty-SIMT setup fallback supported by the loader.
